result_text:
The hook has flagged the same 16 tests again, and nothing has changed since my last message, so my answer is the same.

The check compares test names against the base commit. It will fail for as long as any of those tests is renamed, rewritten or removed. This change reverses the behaviour they assert, so that can't be avoided. I won't restore the old tests, because they would fail against the required behaviour. I also won't keep the old test names while changing what they assert, because that would only get past the detector.

The code change and the rewritten tests are done, and the v4 suite passes (2864 tests). To clear the hook, someone with authority over the test policy has to waive `no-test-edits` for these `__proto__` tests, or tell me which of the two options I laid out last time to take.
